svg.title: Spotify AWS ETL Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end data pipeline: Spotify API → Lambda extraction → S3 raw → Lambda transform → S3 processed → Glue Crawler → Athena analytics

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Spotify OAuth work in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does CloudWatch trigger the Lambda daily?')
sendPrompt('What does the extraction Lambda do?')
sendPrompt('What does the raw S3 folder structure look like?')
sendPrompt('How does the S3 event trigger work?')
sendPrompt('How does the transformation Lambda process the JSON?')
sendPrompt('What are the three CSV entities in the transformed S3 folder?')
sendPrompt('How does the AWS Glue Crawler infer the schema?')
sendPrompt('What tables does the Glue Data Catalog create?')
sendPrompt('What SQL queries can I run in Athena on this data?')
